SHORTCUTS_TEXT:
Navigation
Up and down arrows: move in the lists (left and right move nothing in them)
The app shows one thing at a time: the chat list, or the chat you entered, alone
Tab in the chat list: move between the list and the search button
Tab inside a chat: move between the messages, the message field, and the attach, record and search buttons
Alt+1: return to the chat list
Alt+2: message list
Alt+3: message field
Shift+Enter in the message field: a new line inside the message (can be swapped with Enter in the settings)
Enter on a chat: enter it, with its last message read at once
Enter on a message: play the voice note, open the attachment, vote in the poll, press the bot button, or open the post's comments
Enter on «Load older messages»: load the previous page
Menu key or Shift+F10: context menu for the chat or message
Escape: cancel the last thing in progress (recording, playback, reply, edit, selection, search); if there is nothing, leave the chat for the chat list

Chats
Ctrl+F: find a chat by name
F3: next result
Ctrl+N: new chat with a contact
Ctrl+Shift+N: open a chat by username, phone number, t.me link or invite link
Ctrl+Shift+G: search Telegram globally for people, channels and groups
Ctrl+U: next unread chat
Ctrl+Shift+M: Saved Messages
Ctrl+Shift+R: mark the chat read or unread
Ctrl+I: chat information
Ctrl+PgDn and Ctrl+PgUp: next and previous chat-list view (all, unread, archive, contacts and who is online, folders)

Messages
Enter in the message field: send
Alt+Enter: send without a notification sound
Ctrl+R: reply to the selected message
Ctrl+E: edit my message
Ctrl+D: delete
Ctrl+W: forward
Ctrl+J: react
Ctrl+T: pin or unpin
Ctrl+Space: select or unselect the message
F2: read the message in full
Ctrl+Shift+C: copy the message text
Ctrl+B: press a button in a bot's message
Ctrl+K: open a link from the message
Ctrl+Shift+L: a channel post's comments
Ctrl+Shift+O: group topics
Ctrl+Shift+W: who read the message and who reacted
Ctrl+Shift+V: change voice message playback speed
Ctrl+Shift+E: translate the message to English
Ctrl+Shift+D: describe the selected message's picture with AI (needs a Gemini key in the settings)
Ctrl+Shift+U: message the selected message's sender privately (in groups)
Ctrl+Shift+Y: stories
Ctrl+Shift+F: search within the chat's messages
Ctrl+Alt+F: search the messages of all chats
Ctrl+G: go to a date in the conversation
Ctrl+Shift+B: go to the message replied to

Sending
Ctrl+O: send one or more files (photos and videos are sent as an album)
Ctrl+V in the message field: send copied pictures or files
Ctrl+Shift+K: send a sticker
Ctrl+Shift+T: insert a mention of a group member
Formatting while typing: **bold**, __italic__, `code`, [text](link)
Ctrl+M: start recording a voice message, then Ctrl+M again to send it
Ctrl+Shift+Enter: send the written message later
Ctrl+Shift+P: create a poll

App
Ctrl+Shift+S: settings
Ctrl+L: sign out
Ctrl+Shift+I: Telegram connection status
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+A: open AuraGram from anywhere while it runs in the background
Alt+F4: close the window while the app stays in the background
Ctrl+Q: exit the program for good

SETTINGS_CHECK_UPDATES: Check for a new version when the program opens
ERR_UPDATE_CHECK: Could not find out the latest version right now
MENU_PROBLEM_REPORT: Prepare a problem report for the developer...
MSG_PROBLEM_REPORT_PROMPT: Briefly, what went wrong and what were you doing when it did:
MSG_UNEXPECTED_ERROR: An unexpected error happened and was logged. You can prepare a report of it from the Help menu
ERR_PROBLEM_REPORT: The report could not be saved
PROXY_NOTE: Use a proxy if Telegram is blocked where you are or will not connect. Paste the proxy link and press «Fill from link», or type its details by hand.
MSG_PROXY_FILLED: The proxy details were filled in from the link
ERR_PROXY_LINK: This is not a Telegram proxy link
ERR_PROXY_PORT: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535
ERR_PROXY_FAKE_TLS: This is a disguised proxy (its secret starts with ee), which AuraGram does not support. Use a plain MTProto proxy or SOCKS5.
MENU_DESCRIBE_IMAGE: Describe the selected message's picture	Ctrl+Shift+D
VISION_PROMPT: Describe this picture in English for a blind person, clearly and briefly. If it holds written text, give that text exactly as written after the description. Start with the description itself, with no preamble.
MSG_NOT_AN_IMAGE: The selected message has no picture that can be described
MSG_VISION_NO_KEY: Describing pictures needs a Gemini key of your own. Get one free at aistudio.google.com/apikey, then enter it under Settings, on the «Connection and picture descriptions» tab.
ERR_VISION_KEY: The Gemini key is wrong or not enabled. Check it in the settings.
ERR_VISION_QUOTA: Your Gemini key has run out of quota or made too many requests. Try again in a while.
ERR_VISION_FAILED: The picture could not be described
ERR_VISION_NO_ANSWER: Gemini gave no description for this picture
ERR_VISION_TOO_BIG: The picture is too large to send for describing
SETTINGS_GEMINI_NOTE: To have pictures described, enter a Gemini key of your own here; one is free at aistudio.google.com/apikey. A picture you ask about is sent to Google, and nothing is sent until you ask. The key is kept on this computer only.
SETTINGS_CHAT_KIND_LABEL: The kind of chat (group or channel) in the chat list:
SETTINGS_MESSAGE_STATS_LABEL: Where a message's numbers go (views, comments, reactions):
MENU_MESSAGE_SENDER: Message the selected message's sender privately	Ctrl+Shift+U
MSG_NO_SENDER_TO_MESSAGE: The selected message is not from a person who can be messaged privately
ANNOUNCE_WHAT_WHOLE: Sender name and the whole message
SETTINGS_RECORD_SOUND: Play a tone when a voice recording starts and when it ends, instead of speech that would be recorded
SETTINGS_TIME_STYLE_LABEL: A message's time on its row:
SETTINGS_ENTER_SENDS: Enter sends the message and Shift+Enter starts a new line (when off: Enter starts a new line and Ctrl+Enter sends)
